direct_dependencies.notes: Classifier artifact — natives-linux jar is a self-contained native binary with no compile-scope transitives

mend_detection_expectations.classifier_handling: Mend should detect lwjgl either via the classifier jar filename (lwjgl-3.3.3-natives-linux.jar) or the base coordinates (org.lwjgl:lwjgl:3.3.3). If the classifier is stripped, the artifact appears as lwjgl-3.3.3.jar — both are acceptable but the presence of lwjgl must be confirmed.
mend_detection_expectations.scope_filter_note: Only compile and runtime scope deps should appear in Mend results. Test-scope deps (junit, mockito pulled by httpclient) must be excluded.
